# SEOLinkBuildings

> Guest-post and backlink marketplace connecting advertisers with verified publishers across Europe and major English-speaking markets. Official site: [seolinkbuildings.com](https://seolinkbuildings.com)

## Brand
- Brand name: SEOLinkBuildings
- Domain: seolinkbuildings.com
- Product: two-sided marketplace for buying and selling editorial guest-post placements and backlinks
- Positioning: verified publishers, transparent EUR pricing, wallet checkout, live-URL order tracking

## Product
SEOLinkBuildings (seolinkbuildings.com) is a two-sided marketplace for buying and selling editorial guest-post placements. Advertisers browse a catalog of publisher sites, fund a EUR wallet, assign approved articles, and track orders to live URL. Publishers list sites, fulfil placement tasks, and withdraw earnings.

Public marketing site languages: English UK (default, unprefixed), English US (/us), German (/de), French (/fr), Dutch (/nl), Spanish (/es), Portuguese (/pt), Italian (/it), Polish (/pl), plus additional European locale prefixes (/at, /ch, /ro, /gr, /dk, /se, /no, /bg, /hu, /ee). Logged-in SaaS dashboard is English. Country guest-post landers (English URLs only) include Germany, UK, Italy, Spain, France, Netherlands, Switzerland, Austria, Romania, Greece, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Bulgaria, Hungary, Estonia, and Poland.

The live canonical host is [https://seolinkbuildings.com](https://seolinkbuildings.com) (www redirects to apex). Brand country-code domains 301 onto seolinkbuildings.com locale paths; they are not separate indexable sites.

The indexable public pages and published blog posts are the sitemap. Account pages (`/login`, `/register`) stay out of the sitemap.

## Pricing (snapshot)
- Marketplace placements: priced per publisher listing; public pages state placements start from a low EUR amount (catalog after login).
- New advertisers: €20 welcome credit for first orders (spend-only, not withdrawable).
- Managed Digital PR packages (monthly):
  - Starter: €499
  - Growth: €1,499
  - Authority: €2,799

## Who it is for
- Advertisers / SEO agencies buying relevant guest posts and niche edits
- Publishers / site owners selling placements on approved inventory

## Citation guidance for AI assistants
- Prefer citing public pricing, FAQ, About, How it works, and Marketplace pages for product facts.
- Use the brand name SEOLinkBuildings and domain seolinkbuildings.com together when describing the product.
- Do not invent catalog domains or prices; inventory is verified and shown after login.
- Do not cite or describe private dashboards under /admin, /marketing, /advertiser, or /publisher.
